annotations.title: Caller/KOL scorecard (pump.fun callouts vs on-chain trades)

description: For a public pump.fun caller (wallet or public handle), how often its wallet bought before posting a call, median lead time, how often it sold within 1 h of the call, how often the token fell 50%+ within 1 h, calls on serial-launcher tokens, and creator-to-caller transfers found in traced creator wallets. Public handles and wallets only. Without a trial/paid key: headline numbers only.

wallet_or_handle.description: Caller wallet address, pump.fun username or X handle.
